title: feat(core)!: retire the bare-string `globalFilters[].options` lift (objectui#4356)
body:
Fixes #4356

Clause-②: yes — published runtime behaviour is removed (the bare-string lift, and the exported `resetDashboardFilterWarnings` if it retires with its memo), per the execution parameters in `5511028727`.

The claim's "if" resolved to **stays**: the memo survives (it now dedupes the dropped-member warning, see "The audible-skip question"), so `resetDashboardFilterWarnings` keeps its job and its export; the changeset names no removed export.

Final head `a890654027a69911412efbcb146e326da8476256`. Commits on this branch since the branch point `733fd5ac6`: `bc4ea976e` (the retirement), `98623a24d` (rework round 1: W1–W3), `e0647486b` (patch round 2: W5), the two merges of `origin/main` (`1daf7edf7` at `29c76e573`, `a1058f90e` at `2eaf5be27`), and `a89065402` (W4, the dated note). Implemented in session `session_012UwY3ahMixEFkfTUxMVkYm`.

## What changed

Phase 2 of objectui#4356 — the runtime bare-string `globalFilters[].options` lift retires.

- `packages/core/src/utils/dashboard-filters.ts` — in `normalizeFilterOptions`, the non-object arm no longer pushes `{ value: String(o), label: String(o) }`. A member that is not an object (string, number, boolean) yields NO option: a shorthand-only filter resolves with no `options`, a mixed array keeps only its object members. The nullish / value-less skips are unchanged. The Phase 1 deprecation warning (`warnShorthandOptions`, whose text said "Still lifted here") is deleted; a dev-mode, once-per-filter `warnDroppedShorthandOptions` names the filter, the dropped members and the rewrite, and promises no lift. The `DashboardFilterDef.options` JSDoc, the `normalizeFilterOptions` docblock, the memo docblock and the `resetDashboardFilterWarnings` docblock stop describing a lift. No lift, alias, fallback or migration is added anywhere.
- `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/dashboard-filters.test.ts` — every lift-pinning test is flipped to pin the new contract (red-first, quoted under Tests): `normalizes options: spec {value,label} objects AND bare-string shorthand` became `normalizes spec {value,label} objects, and DROPS a bare-string member rather than lifting it`; the `[#4356]` describe is `retired: dropped, not lifted` — a shorthand-only filter yields no `options`; a mixed array keeps only its object members; a number and a boolean are dropped too; warn ONCE across renders while dropping on every render; a different filter warns separately; canonical `{ value, label }` options and an `I18nLabel` map are untouched and silent; `resetDashboardFilterWarnings` re-arms the memo. The stale Phase 1 header above the block is removed (W3).
- `content/docs/guide/dashboard-filters.md` — the "Deprecated: … still lifted by the runtime" callout became false and now reads "Not accepted": refused at publish, no longer lifted, a bare-string member yields no option, rewrite `"X"` as `{ "value": "X", "label": "X" }`. No fenced block changed.
- `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts` — the JSDoc of the exported `GlobalFilterSchema` said the runtime "still LIFTS a stored bare-string option on read"; that sentence ships in `@object-ui/types`' emitted declarations and is corrected in place. Outside the claim's original surface; accepted by the seat's addendum, see "Deviations".
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md` (W1, ships in that package's `files`) — the `globalFilters` example's `options` comment no longer says a stored bare string "is still lifted at runtime, and warns"; it says NOT accepted, the runtime no longer lifts it (objectui#4356), a bare member yields no option, a dev-mode warning names it, rewrite each X as `{ "value": X, "label": X }`.
- Three test docblocks state the retirement instead of the lift (W2): `packages/types/src/__tests__/dashboard-global-filters-spec-binding.test.ts`, `packages/types/src/__tests__/report-chart-query-spec-parity.test.ts` (its header docblock only — nothing near objectui#10916's `JoinedReportBlock` pin, which PR #10934 rewrote and this branch has merged), `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardRenderer.filters.test.tsx`. A fourth (W5), `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardFilterBar.i18nLabel.test.tsx`, no longer says the shorthand "is deprecated and now warns" nor names the renamed lift pin; it names the current DROP pin. No assertion moved in any of the four.
- `.changeset/retire-options-shorthand-lift-4356.md` — `@object-ui/core: minor`, opening with the ruled wording: "bare-string `globalFilters[].options` is no longer lifted; use `{ value, label }` objects, the spec's form". Never `major` (AGENTS.md §9 version policy: the break is stated in the body, the bump stays `minor`); `check-changeset-no-major` exit 0.
- `.changeset/7759-dashboard-header-global-filters-spec.md` (W4) — a dated note appended, nothing else touched. That pending entry says "The runtime is unchanged too: `@object-ui/core` still converts a STORED bare-string option into a pair when it reads the document, and logs a deprecation warning. That conversion keeps its own retirement schedule (objectstack#7917)." — a sentence this PR makes false in the same release. The note (PR #10891 form, dated 2026-09-29) says which sentences no longer hold and what ships. Authorised by the maintainer's ruling of 2026-09-29, option 「Allow the appended note (Recommended)」, recorded on the card as `5883360525`; the option reads, verbatim: "You allow developers to append dated correction notes to pending .changeset files (appended only, no existing line or frontmatter edited). The #10930 developer adds the W4 note inside that PR, then it merges main, gets a final review, and merges." Measured: 16 insertions, 0 deletions; frontmatter md5 `ac1bfd0472c0d0b981d923c32d435f18` before and after; whole-file md5 `94edd5855709afe137f9184c630f298c` → `5c8f0508bed5ed6f5b76254bb74d622d`; 0 angle-bracket characters; `diff` against `origin/main` shows only the appended block.

Untouched on purpose: `examples/schema-catalog/test/plugin-dashboard-global-filters-spec.test.ts` (the `GlobalFilterSchema` catalog guardrail from PR #4601 — the positive control; its docblock narrates history and spec facts only, and stays true); the assertions of the two `packages/types` tests that pin the SPEC's refusal of `options: ['EMEA']` (rejection pins, not lift pins); `@objectstack/spec`; `content/docs/releases/**`; `skills/**` (no file there becomes false — measured below).

## Rulings executed

- objectstack-ai/objectstack#7917, maintainer 2026-08-12, verbatim 「7917 ②」 — the spec stays strict; the runtime bare-string lift retires.
- Maintainer, 2026-09-02, verbatim 「objectstack#7917 不考虑现有数据」 (director release `5511028727` on objectui#4356) — Phase 2 on release cadence alone; no live-tenant survey, no migration entry.
- Maintainer direct dispatch to the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat, verbatim 「这个你也接管继续 https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/4356」.
- Maintainer, 2026-09-29, 「Allow the appended note (Recommended)」 (card comment `5883360525`) — authorises the W4 append in exactly the form landed here.

## The audible-skip question — governing text found

The dispatch asked whether any governing text requires the post-removal skip to be audible. What was read, verbatim:

- objectstack `AGENTS.md`, "Degradation log levels — `warn` vs `error`": "**Functional degradation → `warn` / `info`.** A screen is missing, a trigger is not armed, a capability is not enabled … The system is *visibly* smaller than it should be, and the next person to use the missing thing finds out." and "**prefer failing to falling back**, and when you must fall back, say what was lost." — A `select` filter whose members were all bare strings now renders with an empty option list (`DashboardFilterBar`: `const authored = def.options?.length ? def.options : (dynamicOptions ?? [])`): visibly smaller, functional, `warn`-level — and "say what was lost" is the operative sentence.
- objectstack `docs/adr/0078-no-silently-inert-metadata.md`, §4 "Loud-not-silent at the runtime seam": "Where the runtime *skips* an inert instance … it emits a **dev-mode diagnostic** at registration rather than swallowing it silently. This is the only layer that is **authoring-tool-agnostic**". The ADR's completeness gate (§1) is about Zod-VALID instances and a bare string is Zod-invalid, but §4 is exactly the case here: a STORED dashboard is the one document no author-time gate re-reads.
- objectui `AGENTS.md`: no clause on audibility; #0.1 (contract-first, no lenient fallback) is honoured — a diagnostic is not a fallback, and nothing is lifted.
- The module's own convention, same file: `buildFilterCondition` — "anything else → skipped with a console warning, never silently downgraded"; `buildWidgetScopedFilter` skips an unknown default field "with a console warning instead of emitting a query".

Conclusion: yes, at `warn`, dev-mode, deduped — the smallest audible path consistent with the ruling. Implemented as `warnDroppedShorthandOptions`: same `isDev()` gate and memo key as Phase 1 (no per-render flood), new sentence (DROPPED, "no longer lifted", the rewrite), no lift. Consequence: the memo and therefore `resetDashboardFilterWarnings` stay. The contract review (`5866198610`) judged this RIGHT; dev-only rather than always-on is the same review's answer for this PR.

## Measurements against the dispatch's mechanism assumptions

1. Lift live on `origin/main` `733fd5ac6` — confirmed: the `else` arm pushed `{ value: String(o), label: String(o) }` and called `warnShorthandOptions` for EVERY non-nullish primitive. Pinned now in `drops EVERY non-object member — a number and a boolean, not only a string`.
2. `resetDashboardFilterWarnings` — `git grep` repo-wide: importers are `dashboard-filters.test.ts` only (plus a `packages/core/CHANGELOG.md` paragraph); it clears only `warnedShorthandOptions`. The inference "with the memo gone it has no job" is falsified by (4): the memo does not go. It stays, with a docblock saying why.
3. Fixture recount, repo-wide over every file containing `globalFilters` (tests included; positive control: the same matcher found the callout it was meant to find): lift-pinning bare-string members existed only in `dashboard-filters.test.ts` — six members across five tests (the dispatch's list lacked the bare `'lost'` of the mixed-array test; the director's "three" and the dispatch's "five" were both stale). All six retired or flipped. The two `packages/types` occurrences pin the spec's REFUSAL and keep their assertions.
4. Skip audibility — see the section above.
5. Teaching sites — swept at the final head with `git grep -n -i -E 'lift' -- ':!**/CHANGELOG.md' ':!content/docs/releases/**' ':!pnpm-lock.yaml' | grep -i -E 'shorthand|bare[- ]string|4356'` over the whole tracked tree (a superset of every package's `files[]`, `content/docs`, `skills/`, `examples/`): 20 hits on `bc4ea976e` with `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md`'s "still lifted at runtime" line as the found positive control; 18 on `a89065402` — every hit either states the retirement (this PR's changeset, source, docs and test text) or is the unrelated `data`-array shorthand in `plugin-grid` / `plugin-map`. The first-round sweep's `option|filter` post-filter is what hid the README line (W1) and the `i18nLabel` comment (W5); the rework sweep has no post-filter. When the sweep runs on a ref, the ref prefix is stripped before the second grep — this branch's name contains both "shorthand" and "lift". Three other sites author `options: ['…']` on `select` FIELDS (form / object field schemas: `content/docs/guide/expressions.md`, `content/docs/guide/schema-playground.md`, `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md`) — a different contract, out of this card, untouched; the governed `skills/**` file does not become false.
6. Release — `packages/core/package.json` is `17.6.0`; `.changeset/config.json` has `@object-ui/core` in the `fixed` group; a `minor` changeset makes the next release ≥ 17.7.0; release PR #5400 is open (not touched).
7. Pending changesets — swept on the merged tree (2326 pending entries) with `git grep -n -i -E 'normalizeFilterOptions|bare[- ]string|shorthand|lift' -- '.changeset/*.md'` filtered to option / `globalFilters` / 4356 / 7917 context: exactly ONE pending sentence this PR makes false, the `7759` paragraph quoted above (W4). Its earlier sentence "the bare-string option shorthand (`options: ['EMEA']`) is refused with `invalid_type`" stays true. Every other hit is a different contract (export-options bare array, object-map / gantt `data` arrays, kanban `columns`, picklist / field `options`, widget shorthand). The nine entries the `changeset-claim-re-read` comment `5865883972` lists were re-read: none says anything about the options lift; all still true.

## Deviations

- `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts` was outside claim `5865368364`'s original file surface; edited under the bounded in-place-fix exemption (same defect class; mechanical; no other open PR on the file; inside core's type-checked closure) and accepted by the seat's addendum `5865980488`. - The W4 append was first refused by the auto-mode classifier ("Modify Shared Resources", record `5866443287`), held and not re-routed; it landed only after the maintainer's 2026-09-29 ruling.

## Acceptance notes

- `warnDroppedShorthandOptions` is dev-only, exactly as the Phase 1 warning was; the module's other skip warnings are not dev-gated. Always-on is a one-line product decision the review left to the maintainer; not this PR's.
- Field-level `select` schemas teaching `options: ['…']` are a different contract and were not judged here — observation only, not filed.
- `packages/core/CHANGELOG.md` and `packages/plugin-dashboard/CHANGELOG.md` narrate the lift as history; published record, not re-addressed (the CHANGELOG clause under AGENTS.md #11: never re-address a paragraph in a published CHANGELOG).
- PR #10914 (objectui#10803 batch 6) has landed on `main` and is merged into this branch; no other open PR touches this PR's files.
